name: ctx-bytes-guard
description: Compacta sozinho quando o payload da conversa passa de 16 MB, antes de cada mensagem e ao fim do turno. Com o synapse-rate-limit instalado, os limites aparecem na linha dos MB.

maxMb.title: Compact at (MB)
maxMb.description: Compact when the conversation payload reaches this many MB

maxPercent.title: Also compact at context (%)
maxPercent.description: Also compact when the context window reaches this percent; 100 means only the MB limit applies
